source_split_manifest.policy: sha256 exact file bytes; train, validation, and locked test must be content-disjoint

dataset.warning: AABB comparison only; it is not a direct replacement for YOLO-OBB oriented cropping.

selection.rule: maximize validation GT recall while preserving baseline validation matched IoU and not increasing unmatched prediction rate; within 1 percentage point of maximum recall, minimize unmatched prediction rate

warnings: AABB comparison only; no OBB metric or oriented-crop claim is made.
WEEE has geometry labels only; no anomaly/defect metric is reported.
